name: get_news
description: Recent provider news with original publisher, URL and publication time (which may be unknown). Limit is 1..50, default 20. Article URLs are data; opening them is an explicit desktop action, not a browser capability.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: get_fundamentals
description: Company fundamentals and profile with source/freshness metadata, optional metrics, earnings/date status and missingness. Preserve provenance; this is not a live quote source.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.

name: get_financials
description: Financial statements with original reporting periods, currency, provider units, source and freshness metadata. Missing values remain missing; annual/quarterly choice belongs to presentation.

symbol.description: US ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B. Resolve ambiguous company names with search_symbols.
